besluite.fout: 'in geen vaste patroon nie' is a wooden construction
besluite.rede: 'sonder 'n vaste patroon' says exactly the same thing in natural Afrikaans and touches no protected wording.

besluite.fout: 'hou' for the contents of a drop reads like English 'hold'
besluite.rede: 'bevat' is the exact Afrikaans verb for what a drop contains, and the meaning is unchanged.
'Die vier maniere wat jy ken' is natural and still says the learner already knows these four methods.

besluite.fout: 'nie' before the definite object sounds contrastive (not the salt, but something else)
besluite.rede: Standard Afrikaans puts the first 'nie' after the definite object, so the proposal removes an unintended contrast without changing what is said.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
besluite.rede: 'Hulle loop ... deur' and 'wat onder uitdrup proe' are two full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma.
'Met die hand sorteer' is one of the four named separation methods and reads correctly as a subject, so the longer 'om te' form is a lateral move that also breaks the method name.
The proposal 'nie afval weer gebruik nie' can be misread as a negated clause, so it is harder to read than the clear original.

besluite.fout: missing comma between two coordinate adjectives
besluite.rede: 'groot' and 'vlak' each describe the dams on their own, and AWS puts a comma between adjectives of equal weight.
'Ná 'n tyd' is natural Afrikaans, and 'ná 'n ruk' suggests a shorter wait than a salt pan needs, so the change is lateral at best.
Temporal 'soos' carries the 'namate' sense (the water gets less as it evaporates), and 'terwyl' narrows that to mere simultaneity.

besluite.fout: the trailing 'as'-phrase after 'uit die oplossing' reads loosely, and the coordinate adjectives lack a comma
besluite.rede: Putting 'as klein, harde kristalle' before 'uit die oplossing' is the natural Afrikaans order, matches the glossary's 'as kristalle uit 'n oplossing kom', and adds nothing.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
besluite.rede: 'al die water is weg' and 'net droë sout bly oor' are two full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma and no words are added.
